description:
Express one WGS84 point in every common notation at once: decimal
    degrees, DMS, DDM, UTM (zone/band/easting/northing), MGRS and USNG,
    British National Grid reference (inside GB only), Geohash, Plus Code,
    Web Mercator metres, the ArcGIS Online "lon, lat" form, the best local
    UTM EPSG code, plus ready-to-open Google Maps / Street View / Google
    Earth / Apple / Bing / OpenStreetMap / Waze links. Pure computation.
    mgrs_precision: 1-5 digit pairs (10 km ... 1 m), default 5.
    Returns JSON: {ok, decimal_degrees, dms, ddm, utm, mgrs, usng, bng,
    geohash, plus_code, web_mercator, agol_format, local_utm_epsg, links}.
name: format_coordinate
